name: Holiday gloves
description: Bright red cotton gloves with a thick roll of white faux fur round each cuff.
notes: Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers towards +z: each 250 mm from fur cuff to fingertip, red cotton with a white faux-fur roll in `fur-pale`. CHECK flags: none. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Sock mitts
description: A pair of cotton socks pulled over the hands, with holes poked through for the fingertips and thumbs.
notes: Rides on batch 125's `nomex_sockmitts` model (slots sock, heel, hole), recoloured as a cream cotton sock with a grey heel, toe and cuff: the same improvised sock with finger holes and a thumb slit, laid flat side by side. No row of its own, so the look step did not check this colouring. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Tentacle sleeves
description: A pair of long knitted cotton sleeves that taper to a closed, rounded end, made to keep a tentacle limb warm.
notes: Laid flat side by side, cuffs towards -z: each 740 mm long, 124 mm wide at a cream ribbed cuff and tapering to a closed, rounded tip, green with cream knitted bands. CHECK flags: none. Slot `arms`, the slot arm guards take; the reference also covers the hands, because the sleeve closes over the tentacle's end, and no slot spans both. For a mutated player whose arms have become tentacles; the item does not need that mutation to exist, only to be worth wearing. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Army winter gloves
description: Thick padded olive gloves quilted across the back, with long cuffs drawn in by a cord.
notes: Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers towards +z: each 300 mm from cuff to fingertip and 100 mm across, olive cotton quilted in darker channels over the back and fingers, with a gauntlet cuff drawn in by a black cord and toggle. CHECK VOLUME: box/volume x6.02 because the pair lies spread flat with long gauntlet cuffs and thumbs out; the reference volume is the pair stacked. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wool sock mitts
description: A pair of wool socks pulled over the hands, with holes poked through for the fingertips and thumbs. Warm even when damp.
notes: Rides on batch 125's `nomex_sockmitts` model (slots sock, heel, hole), recoloured as a grey wool sock with a charcoal heel, toe and cuff. No row of its own, so the look step did not check this colouring. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Ten-gallon hat
description: A brown wool felt hat with a tall creased crown and a wide brim that curls up at the sides. Keeps sun and rain off.
notes: Id `ten_gallon_hat` because the reference id `10gal_hat` starts with a digit, which the row id format rejects. Standing on its brim: 440 mm across, 176 mm tall, brown felt in `cloth-brown` (no brown felt finish exists) with a black leather band and silver buckle, a crease down the crown's top and the brim curling up at both sides. CHECK VOLUME: box/volume x13.88 because the wide brim and hollow crown fill little of their bounding box and the crown is drawn solid; the reference volume packs the hat. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Head bandana
description: A red cotton square printed with white dots, folded corner to corner to tie over the head.
notes: Folded corner to corner and laid flat: a triangle 540 mm along the fold and 270 mm deep, red with a white border and dot print. CHECK flags: none. Slot `hood`, the slot coifs and other head coverings worn under a helmet take, so a hat or helmet can go over it. The reference's tool use, retying it over the mouth, is left out: the tied mouth bandana is its own item and the transform waits on that item. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Beret
description: A soft, flat round cap of navy cotton on a narrow leather headband.
notes: Standing on its band: a soft round crown 270 mm across and 66 mm tall, pushed a little to one side over a black leather headband, with a short stalk on top. CHECK VOLUME: box/volume x18.96 because the crown is drawn solid and the flat round cap fills little of its square box; a real beret folds flat into the reference volume. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
